verdicts.reason: Both candidates use the same broken banner layout. The bottle is shrunk to a tiny, trivial icon, and the four-line body copy is jammed against the left edge of the CTA. The legal text is unreadably small and pushed against the right edge, and decorative dots sit on the body copy. The headline is jammed directly on top of the CTA in both. B wins narrowly because its headline wrap ('Make the / longest day last') matches the original. A's 'Make the longest / day last' leaves an awkward short last line, and B's bottle is slightly smaller still.
